training_note: These are the recorded experiment commands. Existing run IDs are protected against overwrite; use a new ID for a fresh experiment. Exact bitwise continuation is not promised because resume restores weights/optimizer but starts new environment and RNG streams.
selection_note: comparison_200k.json and fixed_comparisons.json preserve the selected 200k-budget checkpoints before the PPO run was resumed. Final difficulty selection is explicitly recorded in selection_lock.json and never uses test-road results.
calibration_commands: python -m rl_course.finalize_v2 freeze-levels --beginner cal_early_ppo --standard cal_pure_ppo --expert cal_rl_s47
evaluate_shipped_game_only: python -m rl_course.evaluate_v2 --deployment --baselines slow rule --episodes 100 --seed-start 891000 --workers 4 --output reproduced_game_test --split test
packaging_note: The delivery archive contains fixed inference models and actual reports. Full training checkpoints, replay buffers and demonstration arrays remain in the original workspace. DQN resume requires its replay buffer; fresh imitation experiments can regenerate the demonstration dataset.
